items.headline: adidas makes the Handball loafer a moccasin
items.caption: The Handball Loafer Freizeit adds moc touches and chunkier soles.
body: Penny loafer up top, sneaker comfort below.
A bit more business casual.
How to wear it: with grey flannels and a cardigan.

items.headline: adidas' icy-blue 'Miami' Samba
items.caption: Palm-tree prints and pink 305 branding, landing right as GTA VI launches.
body: Vice City colours, real-world shoe.
City-themed Sambas keep coming.
How to wear it: white tee, light denim.

items.headline: Nati Lopez gives the adidas Superstar a steel toe
items.caption: The LA tattoo artist swaps the shell toe for diamond-plate metal.
body: Inspired by her favourite work boots.
Silver charms add flash.
How to wear it: with workwear trousers.

items.headline: Meg Stalter leads Marc Jacobs' New York holiday campaign
items.caption: A cast of New York legends stars in the winter campaign.
body: It leans into the city's chaotic winters.
Cosy, funny and very New York.
Style lesson: big coat, bigger personality.

items.headline: You're about to get really into Vans again
items.caption: People are hunting down pairs and paying above retail.
body: Vans used to be the shoe you didn't think about.
Now new releases are creating real buzz.
How to wear it: Old Skools with straight jeans.

items.headline: How Celine's Michael Rider took over menswear
items.caption: GQ's Men of the Year pick turned Celine into the brand everyone discusses.
body: His Paris show was a party.
Preppy '80s energy is back.
Style lesson: relaxed prep, good knitwear.

items.headline: Tom Hardy's most stylish characters, ranked
items.caption: From Inception's sharp con man to RocknRolla's getaway driver.
body: His characters are red flags in great clothes.
Esquire ranks the best looks.
Style lesson: a great overcoat covers a multitude of sins.

items.headline: Esquire's Big Watch Book 2026 is out
items.caption: From Rolex's 70-year-old Day-Date to watches in space.
body: Skiing with Swatch in Japan is inside too.
The year's best watches in one place.
Style lesson: one good watch beats many.

items.headline: Shearling jackets top Esquire editors' week
items.caption: Three of 13 favourite launches were shearling jackets.
body: Including Fortela's grizzly jacket reproduction.
Plus luxury carry-ons.
How to wear it: shearling over a hoodie and jeans.

items.headline: Kevin Love's collection, from vintage Rolex to F.P. Journe
items.caption: The NBA champion's watch taste changed when he won a title.
body: Hodinkee's Talking Watches series.
Milestone watches mean most.
Style lesson: buy to mark your wins.

items.headline: The world's first museum inside a children's hospital opens
items.caption: A dying boy's wish for a place to play during chemo came true.
body: The 'Imaginarium' opened at Children's Hospital New Orleans.
His family's foundation raised the money.

items.headline: A drug may actually cure hormone-driven high blood pressure
items.caption: Baxdrostat reversed the condition, even years after patients stopped taking it.
body: It is FDA-approved.
Doctors were stunned by the study.
